frozen_control.scope: Frozen previous policy exactly reproduces every saved public-observation decision in three accepted-opening experiment games; legality admission is not remeasured here.

historical_replays.scope: Seven historical paid-opening counterexamples: restore only their frozen original opening, verify every original operation/final digest and exact planning observation, then change only the evaluated seat against its recorded opposing order. These are directed regressions, not a new-opening win-rate sample or a guarantee against unknown orders.

limitations: Single fixed loadout and one repetition; 45 seed clusters among 162 games, not independent samples.

17 same-round wins after Invocation are associations, not 17 isolated causal wins.
